scientific_integrity: Analytic extension of a published weighted-sieve argument to one fixed admissible progression; no numerical experiment is used as proof. The local factor at 5 is positive. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The lower bound counts determinant-one matrix representations, not distinct norms; only n congruent to 11 modulo 20 is treated; no explicit lower-bound constant is given.
title: Almost-prime squarefree hyperbolic distances in an admissible arithmetic progression
